result.title: The Cost of Coverage: Conformalising Native Forecast Uncertainty for GB Wind Power
result.summary: Uncertainty bands on wind forecasts help inform reserve sizing and commitments, but often fail to deliver their stated coverage. We apply conformal prediction to native bands to see what it adds and what it costs, comparing six forecasters, from ARIMA to a tabular foundation model, at two wind farms in Great Britain (GB) under operational conditions. We show that calibration repairs empirical marginal coverage with little or no Winkler Score penalty, but this apparent success conceals under-coverage in high winds. Calibrating by forecast wind regime turns marginal coverage into regime-level coverage, cutting day-ahead out-of-band volume in high winds by over 40% relative to pooled calibration while narrowing bands overall.

AI.brief_summary: 论文将 conformal prediction 用于英国两座风电场上六种预报器（ARIMA 到表格基础模型）的原生预测区间，比较校准带来的覆盖收益与 Winkler 分数代价，并发现整体校准会掩盖大风条件下的欠覆盖，进而按风况分层校准。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「边际覆盖达标但条件覆盖失败」的诊断与按工况分层校准思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中停止/弃权决策的置信度校准及分难度、分长度的覆盖评价。
